'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Tim Simon DS Drop''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tim Simon]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title Who's That Driving? Patrick Swayze!!! No numbered Objective; starts [[Drop! (V)]]. Same Drop/tank archetype as Schele. Breached Defenses without (V). Hyperwave Scan (V) as Effect.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Tim Simon]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Drop! (V)]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
